title: Keep matching values
summary: R: Keep matching values. Change the limit to 9.
introduction: A logical test makes true-or-false values. Use them in brackets to keep matching numbers.

blocks.text: Install R. Save an example as lesson.R and run Rscript lesson.R, or paste it into the R console.
The test makes FALSE, TRUE, TRUE. Only the two true positions are kept.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: The filter must describe the values you intend to keep.
